validation_rule: On validation seed 321 (1,000 sigma = 1 deg scenarios per condition) H-a is applied to the primary condition and H-b to the mismatch-off condition. If either fails, the gate stops before seed 322 is generated and the pipeline is fixed. H-c is computed and reported on validation but cannot stop the gate: a small headroom is a result to confirm on test.
forecasts: Stated 2026-11-10 from tuning seed 320 only. H-a: efficiency about 1.25, pass (0.9). H-b: cost point about +3%, pass (0.75; the risk is a point above 5%). H-c on test: R about +1.5%, interval about [-1, +4] at 97.5%, verdict not material (0.85); inconclusive 0.12; material 0.03.
